title.value: Scenario 0.4 - Serve dispense requests of person 'XXX-JANKIE' filtered by pharmaceutical treatment identifier

description.value: Qualification of scenario 0.4 of the Dispense Request Serve use case. See [the qualification documentation on the Nictiz wiki](https://informatiestandaarden.nictiz.nl/wiki/MedMij:V2019.01_Kwalificatie#Medicatiegegevens) for more information.
Filter on specific pharmaceutical treatment identifier

Serve dispense requests of person 'XXX-JANKIE' filtered by pharmaceutical treatment identifier and check the response. In the simulator, set 'filter-identifier' to 'urn:oid:2.16.840.1.113883.2.4.3.11.999.77.1.1|MBH_907_QA1-JNK'. Expect exactly 1 MedicationRequest resource

nts:include.description: Receive a FHIR search on MedicationRequest, including the 'category', 'medicationtreatment' and '_include' parameters, and send a response
